summary: The parent expresses strong opposition to the current policy, stating that parents should always have the option for paper/pencil standardized testing and should be able to opt out of mandated tech use for their children, citing concerns about the effectiveness and research evidence of the mandated technology.

claims.requested_action: Parents should have the right to opt-out of mandated tech use
claims.argument: Parents should always have the option for paper/pencil standardized testing
claims.evidence_quote: Parents should always have the option for paper/pencil standardized testing.
